description:
Construction activity data for Berlin. Source: Amt für Statistik Berlin-Brandenburg.

Shows net changes: building balance, dwelling balance, living-space balance.

Parameters:
- rbs: "stadt" (city) | "bezirk" (Borough) | "stadtteil" | "ortsteil" (District) | "planungsraum" (Neighborhood, LOR Planungsraum)
- bezirk_id, stadtteil_id, ortsteil_id, planungsraum_id: geographic filters
- start/end: period (YYYY, YYYY-MM, YYYY-MM-DD)
- recent: number of most recent periods
- limit, fields, include: "metadata"

Key response fields (German names):
- gebaeude_saldo: Net change in number of buildings
- wohnungen_saldo: Net change in number of apartments
- wohnflaeche_m2_saldo: Net change in living space
name: socio_berlin_construction_activity
title: Berlin Construction Activity
